answers.core: It improves the engine usability out of the box.
answers.workaround:
For GDExtension, I worked around by creating a class in GDScript which stores the classes I want to use inside a Dictionary with the class name as key and the GDScriptNativeClass as value, register it as a singleton with `Engine::register_singleton`, then inside GDExtension I get the dictionary from the singleton to store as a static variable inside the UI class which I can use inside the functions.
It's a workaround, but it takes a few lines to do so.

title: Add a way to get GDScriptNativeClass by name
